name: Bag of Water Elemental Bracers
summary: A bag of water elemental bracers is brought to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver for study. Their magical residue may help him examine the Stone of the Tides’ curse.

sections.title: A Mage’s Study
sections.body: In Dalaran Crater, Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver has been asked to examine the water elemental bracers. At least one bears magical residue, and he believes it may shed light on the Stone of the Tides’ curse. Ansirem knows the legends of the Gurubashi Empire and has written a tome on the subject. Now he turns his attention to the bracers.

faq.answer: The bag holds water elemental bracers for Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver to examine.

faq.q: Who is supposed to study the bracers?
faq.answer: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is asked to study the water elemental bracers in Dalaran Crater.

faq.q: Why does Ansirem want the bracers?
faq.answer: At least one bracer bears magical residue that Ansirem can analyze for clues about the Stone of the Tides’ curse.

faq.q: What does Ansirem know about the Stone?
faq.answer: Ansirem says he knows quite a bit about the Stone of the Tides and has written a tome about legends of the Gurubashi Empire.

angles.text: As a mage, you bring Ansirem a magical puzzle: residue on a water elemental bracer that may help him study the Stone of the Tides’ curse.
